Mahindra Thar Facelift Teased for September 22 Launch

Mahindra is set to launch a facelifted version of its Thar SUV on September 22. The updated model is expected to feature design changes, including a look similar to the Roxx, and new features. The company has teased the upcoming launch, highlighting five key changes in the new iteration of the vehicle.
